text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai, I came up with a new opening 
line! Would you mind giving it a listen?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Bringing a heart of justice to this 
troubled world! The demon Disciplinary 
Committee Head, Bamboo Memory, has 
arrived!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never let rule violations slide! No 
matter the wrongdoing, I'll crack down on 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...H-How is it?! I was aiming for a 
presence that would silence crying 
children...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA! Love it! Now that's what I call 
great spirit! Feels fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For real!? Awesome...! Alright, I'm 
putting it into practice starting 
tomorrow~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's more likely to make a crying 
child cheer up than go quiet, but—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Being looked up to suits Bamboo better 
anyway. Guess I'll just quietly watch over 
her.
